name: stm32f405
description: ST STM32F405xG (Cortex-M4F 168 MHz, 1 MB flash, 128 KB SRAM + 64 KB CCM, USB OTG FS, 3 SPI, 3 I2C, 2 DMA with CHSEL routing): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeF4 HAL/LL, Renode stm32f405 platform (boards come from `embeddyn mechatronics import`)

toolchain.notes: Link with the STM32F405RGTX_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32f405rgtx.s of a CubeIDE project. A whole CubeIDE project builds with `embeddyn mechatronics import` (settings from its .cproject).

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: SysTick and timer clocks follow the RCC (set rcc hseFrequency to the board's crystal, default 8 MHz). SPI DMA requests reach the stream whose CHSEL selects them (STM32F4_DMARequestRouter); the SPIs keep one received byte as the F4 data register does. USB OTG FS is a device: attach `USB.USBSerialHost` (`usbSerial Attach sysbus.usbOtgFs`) to read its CDC port as a UART. Sensors: Sensors.BMI088_Accelerometer/BMI088_Gyroscope (Acceleration* g, AngularRate* deg/s, data-ready Int1/Int3), Sensors.BMP280, Sensors.SPL06_001 (Pressure Pa, Temperature degC), SPI.W25N01GV. For several devices on one SPI use SPI.SPIMultiplexer with multipleSelection: true. Docs: docs/guides/import-a-board.md.

reference.simulator: none; checked with STM32CubeIDE firmware of an STM32F405 IMU board through `embeddyn mechatronics import` (tests/mechatronics/test_importer.py)
